title: BC Crown grazing and reforestation
description: Evidence review for forestry on grazing land, including lease terms, range plans, natural barriers and free-growing obligations.

facts.label: Is there an executed Land Act grazing lease covering the activity area?
Does a confirmed lease clause require a consent that is outstanding or restrict the proposed activity?
Does a confirmed Range Act licence or permit cover this activity area?
Does FRPA §29(0.1), (1) or (2) apply to the harvest and the net area to be reforested before considering exemptions?
Would the proposal keep any of the area to be reforested permanently open for grazing?
Is the area used, or will it be used, exclusively for grazing livestock or cutting hay under that Range Act agreement?
Is harvesting restricted to activities listed in FPPR §44(3), including the exclusive range-use harvest under paragraph (d)?
Does an applicable approved plan clause restrict the proposed harvest or silviculture, or impose an unmet prerequisite?
Would the proposed forest practice directly or indirectly remove or render ineffective a natural range barrier?
Does the 2006 Omineca ADA/SRA order apply to this Crown land and activity after checking the legal boundary, effective date and exclusions?
Does this scenario propose timber harvesting in the area covered by the order?
Was the harvest carried out, or is it proposed, under the order’s Part B forest-health pathway?
Does the activity include site preparation or artificial regeneration such as planting?
